rawText:
Found 14 items in registries @moumenlab:

Showing items 1-14 of 14:

- lab-theme (registry:theme) - Shared design tokens (easings, shadow-border ring, and keyframes) every moumenlab component builds on. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- unlimited-nested-menu (registry:component) - A dropdown where each branch morphs into a stacked sub-panel, no depth limit, fully keyboard driven. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ticket-number-ticker (registry:component) - An odometer that runs digits up on tabular-nums and middle-truncates long ids to start…end, with an optional GitHub PR status badge. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- file-upload-staging (registry:component) - Per-tile interruptible upload state machines with capped concurrency and a layout-glide grid reflow. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- schedule-builder (registry:component) - A recurrence rule as a live English sentence over real occurrences, with month-end and DST traps. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- otp-segmented-input (registry:component) - Six cells that are secretly one real input, with native selection driving the active cell. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- share-permissions-popover (registry:component) - A three-view floating surface that morphs on both axes with a focus trap surviving the swaps. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- command-palette (registry:component) - Commands that take inline argument chips, fuzzy ranking, and a measured height morph. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- morphing-checkout (registry:component) - A three-step card payment with a height:auto illusion, caret-safe masking, a 3D flip, and a FLIP pay button. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- search-expand-nav (registry:component) - A nav bar that expands into a search field then grows into a recent-searches card. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- drag-to-reorder-list (registry:component) - A reorderable list where siblings glide one slot and the drop plays a FLIP, keyboard included. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- caret-mention-popover (registry:component) - An @-mention popover anchored to the text caret via a hidden mirror, gliding as you type. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- hover-expand-icon-strip (registry:component) - Icons in a fixed-width box that expand on hover or Tab while the others squeeze to fit. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- inertial-wheel-list (registry:component) - An iOS picker drum built on native scroll-snap, with selection derived from scrollTop. [@moumenlab] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
